name: Temple Of The Lord
overview: The Temple of the Lord is depicted in Scripture as both a physical place of worship and a spiritual reality. While Isaiah affirms the temple as a house of prayer for all people where sacrifices are accepted, Jeremiah calls for repentance to dwell in this sacred place. However, Acts reminds us that God, the Creator, does not dwell in man-made temples, emphasizing that believers are now part of God's household, a spiritual temple, as Ephesians reveals. Jesus’ observation of the temple’s stones underscores its significance, yet the ultimate dwelling place of God transcends physical structures.
